title: Машинне опрацювання: завдання й результати
fields_and_relations: Exact source/file revisions and SHA-256; immutable job/result digests; tool/model/version/parameters; evidenced text, language, metadata and segmentation candidates; human decisions and applied result revisions.
required_interaction: Запустити/failed/retry; заборонена обробка не стартує; результат не приймається автоматично.

implementation.view_model: List → preparation wizard → portable local job → import actual tool result → candidate-specific human review; text handoff and timed playback
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store v9; additive v1–8 migration without resetting user work or revoked grants
permissions: Scoped text.read/write/review, consent.read/write, processing.run and deposit.manage are independent
Consent evidence is not exposed by text/public/deposit views
Processing and deposit require separate current use decisions
implementation.atomicity: Command validates scope, expected version, exact relationships and immutable hashes before one commit; forms hold drafts until confirmation
limitations: Static hosted UI exchanges job/result files with tools/process_master_job.py; no hosted inference service or background queue.
Local GLM-OCR handles printed/handwritten recognition, Whisper tiny audio/video speech, Qwen3.5 language and grounded metadata. Synthetic samples verify execution, not archival recognition quality.
At most 20 files / 2 MiB total; bundled speech runner accepts up to 120 seconds. No calibrated confidence is fabricated.
Bundled runner does not diarize speakers; externally supplied bounded speaker labels can be reviewed, never automatically identified as people.
Reviewed metadata is an evidenced archival statement, not an automatic authority match, merge or publication.
